description: Cloudflare publishes these ranges on its own cadence, so the bytes cannot be pinned to one reviewed application source SHA the way the rest of the host-security contract is. Binding them to a byte-identical app release would turn every legitimate Cloudflare change into a false alarm, and would make refreshing the list wait on an unrelated code review. This lifecycle governs the same file by shape and provenance instead.

validation._allowed_lines: Judging these bytes by shape instead of by digest must not become 'anything goes'. The file is included into nginx server context, so a directive smuggled in here is a directive on a live vhost. Only these line shapes may appear.
validation._required_networks: Cloudflare may add ranges, and that must stay a quiet refresh. Wholesale substitution is different: replacing the list with somebody else's networks hands them the right to speak for any visitor. These long-standing Cloudflare networks must still be present.
